capabilities: Display a customizable dashboard with banner, title, and calendar
Show a 52-week vault activity heatmap and vault overview statistics
List favorite notes automatically by open count or from a manual list
Configure project boards with folders, status, and featured notes
Provide quick access actions and lightweight filename/content search
disambiguation: Not a daily journal, task manager, habit tracker, or writing analytics tool; it is a read-and-retrieve-oriented vault homepage.
extras: Manual installation only; Community Plugins submission is still pending. Desktop-only (Obsidian 1.5.0+). Activity tracking is minimal and local-only; the README documents banner cropping guidelines, data storage locations, and folder-rename migration steps for older versions.
motivation: The author uses Obsidian as a knowledge library for reading, browsing, and retrieval rather than journaling, and wanted a visual home page that works on top of an existing vault without restructuring notes around it.
problem: Existing dashboard workflows are built around daily notes, tasks, habits, or a manually maintained home note, which does not suit browsing-oriented knowledge vaults.
summary: Configurable dashboard start page that shows a banner, calendar, activity heatmap, vault stats, favorite notes, quick actions, and project boards.
